name: [x] Portal
comment: Portal 2 on the Xbox scheme (StrategyWiki Portal 2/Controls): LS move, RS look, A jump, B crouch, X use, RT blue portal, LT orange portal, RB zoom, LB ping (co-op), D-pad co-op gestures, Start pause. Right side is one large GYRO-RSVPAD: touching it swipes the camera and turns gyro on (aim by tilting while the thumb rests), sensitivity 18 with minStickOffset 8700 (XInput right-stick dead zone) and gyro dead-zone compensation 7000. Fire buttons sit one per thumb (orange left, blue right) so aiming and firing never need the same finger. No combos, no gyro on buttons; Y, push-to-talk, the plain RSVPAD and the bumper-radial folder with its LB/RB stick pads removed.
